Why is the title playful rather than a literal description of human hands?
items.explanation: Elephants do not hold human hands in the scene. The poet compares their trunk-and-tail connection with people holding hands.

What effect does repeating the idea of holding tails have?
items.explanation: The repetition emphasises how the elephants stay linked and gives the short poem a memorable rhythm.

items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-07: Holding Hands
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.
What is one reasonable main idea of the poem? Support your answer.
items.explanation: One main idea is the connection of elephants moving together. The repeated image of holding tails presents them as a linked group, like people holding hands.

What does “It never fails” suggest in the poem’s playful description?
items.explanation: It suggests that the elephants keep doing this when they walk. This is the poem’s description, not scientific proof about every elephant.
